maturity.description: Section 30 of the transformation spec. Maturity must not exceed what real evidence supports.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the lab's real code/tests.

covers_competencies.description: Codex final-verification fix (N1): the set of competencies this lab actually, concretely exercises (a real protocol/tool/technique it runs against real code) — not a maturity claim. A PRACTICED_IN edge from a competency to this lab is only semantically valid if the competency's id appears here; see validate-registry.mjs's PRACTICED_IN coverage-semantics check. An empty/absent list means this lab declares no competency coverage yet, so no PRACTICED_IN edge may target it.
